description: Deep search across all media transcripts, insights, and metadata. Returns matching media with sentiment data, tags, and content excerpts. Use this to find specific topics, keywords, or themes across your entire library. For filtering by media type, folder, tags, or speakers, use the filterList parameter. Results are scoped by date range — defaults to current year if not specified.

endDate.description: End date for search range (ISO 8601). Defaults to now.

filterList.description: Advanced filters for narrowing search results by tags, speakers, media type, sentiment, folder, etc.

query.description: Search query — searches across transcripts, insights, and metadata

startDate.description: Start date for search range (ISO 8601). Defaults to start of current year.

name: search_media

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: Search Media Library
